# Varieties Watch Shop

> Original watches in Bangladesh — men's, women's, couple, and luxury watches with nationwide cash on delivery.

Varieties Watch Shop sells authentic branded watches across Bangladesh from showrooms in Dhaka (Shantinagar) and Chattogram (Chawkbazar). Compare watch prices in BD and order online.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured watches, brands, and customer reviews.
- [All Watches](/collection/all): Full collection across all categories.
- [Men's Watches](/collection/mens): Men's watch prices in Bangladesh.
- [Women's Watches](/collection/womens): Women's watch prices in Bangladesh.
- [Couple Watches](/collection/couple): Couple watch sets.
- [Brands](/brands): Browse by brand.
- [Reviews](/reviews): Verified customer reviews.
- [Track Order](/track-order): Look up an order by phone or order number.
